review.notes: Full review. One P2 finding: the third Check of 5.3 gives a range (1.2 to 1.5) that the stated coefficients do not produce (1.10 at N = 1, recomputed by hand and by program). All 29 theorems passed the adversarial pass; the radix-2 factorizations (t = 0..6), the cost formula (t = 1..8), Cooley-Tukey, Good-Thomas, Rader and Bluestein were recomputed from the Lean definitions. Sample of 15 targets: mathematics verified, but no source locator could be checked against its text (PPST, CHQZ, STW, K paywalled; SB and I with no legal copy). Automatic checks: dependency check clean (0 problems), Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning, one-tactic probe closes none of the 29 theorems; the TeX-syntax check is a format note; the empty-section-header check was set aside as a false positive. Ownership checked against main and the open pull requests: no second owner; Tau Ceti's CircleSobolev is not cited (small correction).
